newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends off on post-holiday dlr demand.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends off on post-holiday dlr demand.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed 2.05 lower against the U.S. currency at 1,080.6 on a surge of dollar demand in the wake of a bank holiday Monday, dealers said.
Initially, the peso was lifted as dollar coffee export earnings and petrodollars flowed into the market during much of the morning.
But the peso changed tack as a need for dollars after the holiday as well as high demand from pension funds pushed the Colombian currency into negative territory.
Dealers reported 336 trades for more than $161 million.
The peso opened at 1, 078 against the dollar, cresting at 1,077.1 with an intraday low of 1,081.7.
